tasks.task: Fix research pipeline adapter scoring to allow compliant policies to achieve 'HIGH' evidence quality and 'covered' status
tasks.evidence: In research/src/research/pipeline_adapter.py, _stub_search_fn normalises keyword hits over the entire union of all element keywords and contradiction cues, resulting in scores < 0.30 (below PARTIAL_SCORE). The engine falls back to RELIABLE_SCORE (0.40), making evidence.quality permanently 'MEDIUM'. In compliance/src/compliance/classify.py, 'covered' strictly requires quality == 'HIGH'. Thus TP=0 and Recall=0 across all configs.
tasks.completion_criteria: Fully compliant test cases (e.g. SYN_009, SYN_026) produce evidence.quality == 'HIGH' and status == 'covered' under baseline retrieval; Precision and Recall > 0.0.

tasks.task: Wire ElementDecomposer outputs into classification status decision in research adapter
tasks.evidence: In research/src/research/pipeline_adapter.py lines 359-373, ElementDecomposer.assess_elements is executed after classify_duty() has already returned status. It only modifies satisfied_elements on PredictionResult and does not affect the predicted status.
tasks.completion_criteria: When use_element_decomposition=True, satisfied elements discovered by ElementDecomposer contribute to the element satisfaction ratio and directly influence whether status is 'covered', 'partial', or 'missing'.

tasks.task: Wire DenialPolarityDetector to trigger contradiction/violation or disqualify coverage in classification
tasks.evidence: In research/src/research/pipeline_adapter.py, DenialPolarityDetector only filters SearchHits in stub search, but clauses are still passed to gather_evidence. The detected polarity findings are recorded only in diagnostics and do not override or inform classify_duty.
tasks.completion_criteria: Cases containing direct denials (e.g. SYN_022, SYN_027) transition from 'partial' to 'violation' or 'missing' when use_denial_polarity=True, differentiating Config C/D from Config A/B.

tasks.task: Conduct multi-annotator agreement study (Inter-Annotator Agreement / Cohen's Kappa)
tasks.evidence: All cases currently list annotator='R001' and adjudication='single'. Reviewers in legal NLP / compliance venues reject single-annotator subjective datasets without reported kappa or legal expert verification.
tasks.completion_criteria: A subset (>= 30%) of cases double-annotated by a second annotator, with reported Cohen's Kappa (target kappa >= 0.70) and documented adjudication protocol.

tasks.task: Run evaluation over full dataset across Configurations A, B, C, D and verify statistical divergence

tasks.completion_criteria: Evaluation report demonstrates non-trivial precision/recall/F1, with Config B showing higher element F1, Config C reducing false-covered count/rate on denial cases, and Config D achieving optimal balanced F1.
